reason: DanRAG-Bench is a well-documented, MIT-licensed Danish retrieval benchmark. The 471 query-answer pairs are grounded in 349 real public-sector pages and manually verified; text-only corpus records were extracted to verify mappings. The canonical corpus Parquet containing 300 DPI page images was not downloaded per the no-large-image/PDF policy, and there is no train/dev/test split. Score 76/100 places it in the eval-candidate band, capped at TECHNICALLY_VERIFIED_CANDIDATE.
